notes: Insect Swarm RAW (le_monster_catalog_2_summary.xml): auto-hit 2 pts/round on the swarm's initiative tick, double damage to characters wearing no armor or monsters with AC 3 or worse, halved if the character wards the swarm off or runs out of it. Applied while the target occupies a swarm-claimed cell; persists 3 rounds after leaving. Cleared on entering a water cell (tagging deferred until terrain-water-tag landing). Damage is delivered by SpellCombatHooks._tick_insect_plague reading this condition; warding-attack damage clamp is in attack_resolver/ranged_attack_resolver.
description: Engulfed by an insect swarm. Takes auto-hit damage every round on the swarm's initiative. Damage doubles vs. unarmored / AC 3 or worse, halves while warding or fleeing. Persists 3 rounds after leaving the swarm; clears immediately on entering water.

notes: Rat Swarm RAW (le_monster_catalog_2_summary.xml). Same auto-hit damage cadence as insect swarm; provided as a separate key so future spells (e.g. summon-rat-swarm) can target the right kind of swarm without overloading swarmed_insect.
description: Engulfed by a rat swarm. Takes auto-hit damage every round on the swarm's initiative. Damage doubles vs. unarmored / AC 3 or worse, halves while warding or fleeing. Persists 3 rounds after leaving; clears on entering water.

notes: Bat Swarm RAW (le_monster_catalog_2_summary.xml): bats inflict Confusion (as the spell, that round), not direct damage; tick_damage_per_round is 0. Per-round Confusion application is handled outside this condition (deferred — bat swarms aren't summonable from the L5 spells covered by this session). Provided here so the schema covers all three swarm flavors and future content can wire the confusion-on-tick hook through.
description: Engulfed by a bat swarm. Forced to roll save vs. Spells each round on the swarm's initiative; on failure, suffers Confusion (as the spell) for that round. No direct damage. Persists 3 rounds after leaving; clears on entering water.

notes: Cause Disease (acore_spell_catalog_a-i_summary.xml: -2 attack throws while afflicted; cannot be magically healed; natural healing at half rate; fatal in 2d12 days unless Cure Disease cast). Death-timer + half-natural-healing rate are tracked in active_effect metadata; the no-magic-healing gate consumes the condition_key at heal-resolution time (deferred polish — _apply_heal could check entity.has_condition('diseased') and refuse).
description: Afflicted with a wasting plague. -2 to attack throws. Cannot be magically healed. Heals at half normal natural rate. Fatal in 2d12 days unless Cure Disease is cast.

notes: Entangled by Web spell (acore_spell_catalog_k-w_summary.xml). Cannot move or run/charge. Can still attack and cast normally. Escape time depends on strength category: 2d4 turns (normal/weak), 1 turn (STR 13-17), 4 rounds (STR 18+), 2 rounds (giant/great strength). Web is flammable — if ignited, takes 2 rounds of fire damage then frees survivors. Escape mechanics deferred to web_resolver active_effect; mechanical condition is the movement gate.
description: Entangled in Web spell strands. Cannot move, run, or charge. Attack and cast normally. Escape time depends on strength.

notes: Target regards caster as trusted friend and ally; interprets caster's words and actions favorably (acore_spell_catalog_a-i_summary.xml). No mechanical penalties — behavioral state only. Monster AI reads the condition_key to switch sides; integration is a future polish.
description: Charmed by the caster. The target regards the caster as a trusted friend and ally and interprets words and actions favorably. The target retains full agency in combat; it simply will not act against the caster's interests.

notes: Confusion spell (acore_spell_catalog_a-i_summary.xml: 12 rounds, 30' radius, up to 3d6 living creatures, save vs Spells if >2 HD; ≤2 HD no save). Each round on the affected creature's initiative, roll 2d6 against the confusion behavior table: 2-5 attack caster/allies, 6-8 babble, 9-12 attack own party. If indicated action impossible, babbles instead. Confused creature attacked by another auto-retaliates next turn if still confused. Per-round behavior dispatch lives in monster AI / combat controller — this condition flags the state and the AI consumes the table. No special advantage when attacking a confused creature.
description: Mind clouded by Confusion. Each round rolls 2d6 on the confusion behavior table to determine actions: attack caster/allies, babble, or attack own party. Cannot make rational decisions about its actions.

notes: Generic poisoned state — gate consumed by Neutralize Poison (acore_spell_catalog_k-w_summary.xml). Per-poison-type damage / save cadence is owned by the specific poison source (Cause Disease pattern: damage timer + save schedule on the active_effect metadata). Neutralize Poison removes the condition AND the underlying active_effect; if the creature died from poison within the last 10 rounds, Neutralize Poison revives at 1 hp (special-case in the resolver, not the condition). No mechanical penalty intrinsic to the condition — the poison source carries the damage; this condition tags the state for the curative gate.
description: Suffering from poison. The specific poison source determines damage and ongoing effects. Neutralize Poison clears this condition and the underlying poison effect.

notes: Tag for undead/enchanted creatures destroyed by Dispel Evil (acore_spell_catalog_a-i_summary.xml: failed save vs Death → destroyed). Mechanically equivalent to dead — entity is removed from combat by the consumer-side destruction routine, but this condition tags the state for the routine to consume (parallel to mortal_wounds_resolver pattern). The actual mob-removal happens in SpellCombatHooks / MonsterAI on next tick.
description: Destroyed by Dispel Evil. Cannot act. Will be removed from combat by the destruction routine.

notes: Bound by a divine Quest (acore_spell_catalog_k-w_summary.xml). Recipient must follow the instructions until the quest is completed. Open-ended quests last max 1 day per caster level. Ignoring the quest accumulates Judge-chosen penalties (combat penalties, lowered ability scores, lost spells, pain, weakness, eventually death) until obedience resumes or recipient dies. Penalties removed 24h after recipient resumes obeying. Dispel magic does NOT affect Quest; only Reverse Quest, Remove Curse from caster ≥2 levels higher, or Wish ends it. Mechanically the condition flags the state — the runtime layer's quest-tracker subsystem consumes the condition + active_effect to enforce penalties; for now the condition is the marker.
description: Bound by a Quest spell. Must follow the caster's instructions until the quest is completed or dispelled. Disobedience accrues cumulative magical penalties.

notes: Bound by an arcane Geas (acore_spell_catalog_a-i_summary.xml). Stronger than Quest — the geas LASTS forever (until the geas is completed) for non-open-ended tasks; open-ended max 1 day per caster level. Same penalty cascade as Quest (Judge-chosen cumulative penalties until obedience or death). Dispel magic does NOT affect geas. Only Remove Curse / Wish / Reverse Geas can end it; 5% per-level fail rate when removing caster is lower than imposing caster. The condition tags the state for the quest-tracker subsystem (deferred polish).
description: Bound by a Geas. Cannot ignore the imposed task without suffering cumulative magical penalties. Only Remove Curse, Wish, or Reverse Geas can end it.

notes: Disintegrated by the Disintegrate spell (acore_spell_catalog_a-i_summary.xml: save vs Death negates; on fail, target reduced to dust; equipment unaffected). Mechanically equivalent to dead — the body is gone (only equipment remains). Cannot be raised by Raise Dead (which restores from corpse); requires Wish or similar reality-rewriting magic. The destruction routine consumer (combat_controller / mortal_wounds_resolver) reads the condition to remove from combat + flag the body as 'dust'.
description: Reduced to dust by Disintegrate. Equipment is unaffected. The creature is dead and cannot be Raised normally.

notes: Cannot see. -2 to surprise, -4 to attacks, movement at 1/4 rate.
description: Cannot see. Takes -2 to surprise rolls, -4 to attack throws, and moves at 1/4 normal rate.

notes: +2 attack, -2 AC, double damage on hit. Condition ends after the attack.
description: Charging into melee. +2 to attack throw, -2 to AC, double damage on a hit. Ends after the attack is resolved.

notes: Cannot attack, cast, move, or speak, but can defend normally.
description: Overcome by choking or vomiting. Cannot attack, cast spells, move, or speak, but retains normal defenses.

notes: Maintaining a concentration spell. Concentration breaks if damaged, save failed, attacks made, spells cast, or excessive movement taken.
description: Maintaining a concentration spell. Concentration is broken if the concentrator takes damage, fails a saving throw, makes an attack, casts another spell, or moves more than 30 feet in a round.

notes: Stricter form of concentration; breaks on any movement or any action-in-lieu.
description: Maintaining a stationary concentration spell. Concentration breaks if the caster moves at all, takes any action, takes damage, or fails a saving throw.

notes: Weapon knocked 5' away. Must spend action to retrieve or fight unarmed (brawl).
description: Weapon has been knocked from hand. Must spend an action to retrieve the weapon or fight unarmed using brawling rules.

notes: -2 surprise, -4 to ceremony/spellsinging, 2-in-6 (~33%) spell casting failure chance.
description: Cannot hear. -2 to surprise rolls, -4 to ceremony and spellsinging throws, and a 2-in-6 chance of spell failure when casting.

notes: In melee. May not move freely; only defensive withdrawal or defined tactical movements allowed.
description: In melee combat. Cannot move freely — only defensive withdrawal or specific tactical movements permitted.

notes: Cannot run or charge. Requires 1 turn of rest to end.
description: Severely fatigued. Cannot run or charge. The condition ends after 1 turn (10 minutes) of rest.

notes: Accumulates -1/day to attack throws, proficiency throws, and damage rolls.
description: Growing fatigue imposes a cumulative -1 penalty per day to attack throws, proficiency throws, and damage rolls.

notes: Cannot attack, cast spells, speak coherently, or follow complex instructions.
description: Reduced to animal-level intelligence. Cannot attack, cast spells, speak coherently, or follow complex instructions.

notes: Cannot attack, cast, or speak. Flees from source of fear; if unable to flee, cowers (-2 AC).
description: Overcome by fear. Cannot attack, cast spells, or speak. Must flee from the source of fear; if flight is impossible, cowers in place taking a -2 AC penalty.

notes: Cannot attack, cast, move, or take actions except attempt escape. Is vulnerable.
description: Grabbed by an enemy. Cannot attack, cast spells, move, or take any action except attempt to escape. Is also Vulnerable.

notes: Like Grabbed but via wrestling rules. Cannot attack, cast, move, or take actions except attempt escape. Is vulnerable.
description: Held by wrestling. Cannot attack, cast spells, move, or take any action except attempt to break free. Is also Vulnerable.

notes: Movement at ≤1/2 rate. Cumulative -1 per round to attacks (to -5 max).
description: Spinning or reeling uncontrollably. Movement at half rate or less. Attack throw penalty starts at -1 and worsens by 1 each round, to a maximum of -5.

notes: Fully immobile. Melee attacks auto-hit. Attackers gain +2 melee / +4 ranged to hit.
description: Completely unable to act or move. Melee attacks against this target automatically hit. Ranged and other attackers gain +4 to hit.

notes: +2 attack, -2 AC. Must attack nearest creature. Immune to fear. Does not check morale.
description: Overcome by battle rage. +2 to attack throws, -2 to AC. Must attack the nearest creature. Immune to fear effects and does not make morale checks.

notes: +2 attack, -2 AC. Cannot declare defensive movement (Full Retreat / Fighting Withdrawal). Immune to fear. Lasts until combat ends.
description: Berserker rage from the Berserkergang proficiency. +2 to attack throws, -2 to AC. Stacks with Charge. Cannot retreat from combat. Immune to fear effects. Once begun, lasts until combat ends.

notes: Cannot attack, cast, move, or speak, but can defend normally. Not vulnerable.
description: Entranced or hypnotized. Cannot attack, cast spells, move, or speak, but retains normal defenses and is not considered vulnerable.

notes: Cannot attack, cast, or speak. Can only move away from source of nausea. Can defend normally. Not vulnerable.
description: Overcome by nausea. Cannot attack, cast spells, or speak. Movement only permitted away from the source of nausea. Retains normal defenses and is not vulnerable.

notes: Helpless and cannot speak. Melee attacks auto-hit. +2/+4 to hit.
description: Cannot move, attack, cast spells, or speak. Treated as Helpless: melee attacks automatically hit, attackers gain +4 to hit with ranged.

notes: Turned to stone. Helpless. Immune to most spells except Stone to Flesh or Disintegrate. Takes structural damage instead of HP damage.
description: Turned to stone. Treated as Helpless. Immune to most magical effects; only Stone to Flesh or Disintegrate can affect the target. Takes structural damage from physical attacks.

notes: -4 to attack throws. Attackers gain +2 melee / +4 ranged to hit. Crawl movement only.
description: Knocked down. -4 to attack throws. Melee attackers gain +2 to hit; ranged attackers gain +4 to hit. Movement is limited to crawling.

notes: Cannot attack or cast. Movement at 1/4 rate. Cannot recover above 1 HP while recuperating.
description: Recovering from a mortal wound. Cannot attack or cast spells. Movement at 1/4 rate. Cannot recover HP above 1 until recuperation ends.

notes: Cannot move but CAN attack and cast. Is vulnerable.
description: Bound or restrained in place. Cannot move, but can still attack and cast spells. Is also Vulnerable.

notes: Asleep and helpless. Cannot see, hear, or speak. Melee auto-hit. Condition ends on attack, damage, or loud nearby movement.
description: Deeply asleep. Treated as Helpless. Cannot see, hear, or speak. The condition ends immediately if the target is attacked, takes damage, or there is loud nearby movement.

notes: Cannot attack, cast, move, or take any action. Is vulnerable (but not helpless).
description: Dazed and incapacitated. Cannot attack, cast spells, move, or take any action. Is Vulnerable but not fully Helpless.

notes: Helpless. Ends on wound treatment or 24 hours; both trigger a mortal wounds roll.
description: Knocked unconscious. Treated as Helpless. Condition ends when wound treatment is applied or after 24 hours; either event triggers a mortal wounds roll.

notes: No shield AC. Can be ambushed/backstabbed. +2 melee / +4 ranged to hit.
description: In a position of weakness or exposure. Shield bonus to AC is ignored. Can be ambushed or backstabbed. Melee attackers gain +2 to hit; ranged attackers gain +4 to hit.
